title: Supported generation of ind-finite-complex hearts
statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a condensed commutative ring Λ in the five coefficient families of [sk-def-localizing-closure]: finite discrete ℓ-primary rings, Z_ℓ, integers of a finite extension, Q_ℓ, a finite extension. Let X be qcqs and M be an ordinary internal Λ_X-module in indFiniteConstructibleComplexHearts Λ X [def-sfb-finite-constructible-complex-heart-presentations]. Then M[0] belongs to supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X [lem-sfb-supported-image-bounded-derived-generation]. No closure of the ind-finite-heart class under arbitrary kernels is asserted.

proof.text: For a complex K, first use 0→ker(d0)→K0→im(d0)→0 to generate its cycles. The image of d(-1) is canonically isomorphic to the image of the map into cycles. The exact sequence from that boundary image to cycles to H0(K) gives H0(K)[0] by a second distinguished triangle. The outer objects are generated by the preceding image argument.

theorem indFiniteHeart_mem_supported_derived_generation
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : indFiniteConstructibleComplexHearts Λ X M) :
    supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
